name: Prepare iodoform
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: Manual of Microscale Chemistry Laboratory Kit, Chapter Preparation of Compounds, Experiment 6.7; exact PDF pages to verify during citation pass
educational_goal: Perform the Class 12 microscale chemistry experiment 'Prepare iodoform' and record its manual-defined observations and result.
materials: methyl ketone or ethanol, iodine, sodium hydroxide, water, test tube, filter
safety_notes: Follow the supplied manual and teacher supervision for quantities, heating, acids, bases, organic solvents, and waste disposal.
Wear eye protection and do not taste or directly handle chemicals.

gaps: lelm108.pdf p4 contains diagnostic iodoform tests, not this preparative experiment. See chem_12_402 variants; no scale substitution made.
